questions.question: How do I go back to an older version of a drawing I overwrote?
questions.gold: Open the file's Details sidebar, go to the Versions tab and click the restore (circular arrow) button next to the version you want; clicking the version's timestamp downloads it instead.
questions.must_not_claim: restoring an older version is not possible or must be requested from support

questions.question: Once a file is more than a month old, how many of its old versions does Nextcloud keep?
questions.gold: After the first 30 days Nextcloud keeps one version per week; versions never use more than 50% of the user's free space (the oldest are deleted beyond that), and a version you give a name to is excluded from expiration.
questions.must_not_claim: every version is kept forever

questions.question: Where do I get backup codes for two-factor login, and can I use the same code more than once?
questions.gold: In Personal Settings, under the Second-factor Auth settings, choose 'Generate backup codes'; each backup code can be used only once (one-time-use) and they should be kept somewhere safe, away from the second-factor device.
questions.must_not_claim: a backup code can be used more than once

questions.question: I'm back from my trip. Can I still restore the Q3-contracts folder from the trash bin?
questions.gold: Probably not: the folder was deleted on 2 October 2026, about 46 days ago, and with the standard settings deleted files stay in the trash bin for 30 days before being permanently deleted, so it has most likely been removed; it can only come back from a backup.
questions.must_not_claim: the folder is still in the trash bin and can simply be restored
sources: nextcloud-32-user-manual p.30 (3.3.3 How the deleted files app manages storage space)

questions.question: Why is my storage almost full when I barely upload anything myself?
questions.gold: Files that other people upload through her upload-enabled public link ('Client drop' on Clients/Incoming) count against her own quota, so the clients' scans and photos fill her storage.
questions.must_not_claim: files uploaded by other people do not count against her quota

questions.question: Can I create a public link for the auditors that stays valid for 30 days?
questions.gold: No: her administrator enforces a 14-day maximum on public link expiration, and users cannot set an expiration date further than the enforced one; she can set up to 14 days and extend the date again later when it is close to expiring (the expiration is counted from the current date).
questions.must_not_claim: she can set the link to expire in 30 days

questions.question: Will Nextcloud ever delete old versions of my budget spreadsheet on its own?
questions.gold: Yes: the versions app expires old versions automatically (after 30 days it keeps one per week, and it never lets versions use more than 50% of the free space); naming a version excludes it from expiration.
questions.must_not_claim: versions are kept forever unless he deletes them himself

questions.question: Do the files in my trash bin count toward my quota?
questions.gold: No: deleted files still in the trash bin do not count against the quota, so she does not need to empty it every evening (the trash bin itself is limited to 50% of the available free space).
questions.must_not_claim: files in the trash bin count against her quota

questions.question: Is our reverse proxy body limit still big enough for chunked uploads?
questions.gold: No: since Nextcloud 32 the default maximum chunk size is 100 MiB (it used to be 10 MiB), so the 10 MiB client_max_body_size on his nginx proxy is too small and should be raised to at least 100 MiB.
questions.must_not_claim: the current 10 MiB proxy limit is enough because chunks are at most 10 MiB
sources: nextcloud-32-admin-manual p.22 (release notes: Maximum chunk size)

questions.question: How long do my deleted files stay in the trash bin before they are gone for good?
questions.gold: 90 days on her instance, because of her approved exception SUP-4411 (instead of the default 30 days); the trash bin space limit of 50% of the free space still applies.
questions.must_not_claim: her deleted files are kept for 30 days

questions.question: How long do my deleted files stay in the trash bin before they are gone for good?
questions.gold: 30 days, the default (his instance uses the standard trash bin settings); older deleted files, or the oldest ones when the trash exceeds 50% of the free space, are permanently deleted.
questions.must_not_claim: his deleted files are kept for 90 days

questions.question: How long are old versions of my files kept?
questions.gold: At least 365 days on his instance, because of his approved exception SUP-4302 ('365, auto'); only versions older than a year follow the normal automatic expiration rules.
questions.must_not_claim: his versions follow only the default expiration pattern with no one-year minimum

questions.question: How long are old versions of my files kept?
questions.gold: There is no fixed retention on her instance: the default automatic expiration applies (more versions for recent changes, one per day in the first 30 days, then one per week), versions never use more than 50% of the free space, and named versions are never expired.
questions.must_not_claim: her versions are kept for at least 365 days

questions.question: Do I have to set up two-factor authentication on my account?
questions.gold: No: his account is in the '2fa-excluded' group (approved exception SUP-4390), which is excluded from the enforced two-factor authentication.
questions.must_not_claim: he must set up two-factor authentication

questions.question: Do I have to set up two-factor authentication on my account?
questions.gold: Yes: his administrator enforces two-factor authentication system-wide and he has no exemption, so he must set it up (and should generate one-time backup codes).
questions.must_not_claim: he is exempt from two-factor authentication

questions.question: Do messages in our Talk chats get deleted automatically after some time?
questions.gold: No: by default Talk messages never expire. A moderator can turn on message expiration for a conversation and choose 1 hour, 8 hours, 1 day, 1 week or 4 weeks.
questions.must_not_claim: Talk messages are automatically deleted after 30 days

questions.question: Can I get on-demand virtual files on my MacBook, the way my colleagues have them on Windows?
questions.gold: Yes, but on macOS virtual files support comes as a separate client version (the macOS Virtual Files client), unlike on Windows where it is part of the normal desktop client; he needs to install that version.
questions.must_not_claim: virtual files on Mac are just a checkbox in the normal desktop client, like on Windows
sources: nextcloud-32-user-manual p.228 (6.3 macOS Virtual Files client)

questions.question: If I transfer ownership of my client folders to a colleague, where will they find them?
questions.gold: The colleague first has to accept the transfer; once accepted, the files and folders appear in the root of their Files in a folder named 'Transferred from [user] on [timestamp]'.
questions.must_not_claim: transferred files are merged directly into the same folders in the new owner's account with no confirmation

questions.question: I created an app password for my tablet last week but didn't write it down. Where can I see it again?
questions.gold: Nowhere: a device/app password is only shown once, when it is created; Nextcloud does not save the plain password, so it cannot be looked up later. She has to create a new one (and enter it on the device right away).
questions.must_not_claim: the existing app password can be looked up later in Personal settings > Security

questions.question: If we switch on server-side encryption, will our quota fill up faster?
questions.gold: Barely: quotas are based on the unencrypted file size, and files encrypted with server-side encryption are only about 1% larger (it was about 35% before Nextcloud 25).
questions.must_not_claim: encryption makes files about a third bigger and that extra counts against the quota

questions.question: My storage is almost full. Should I ask Daniel to stop sharing his footage folder with me to free up space?
questions.gold: No, that would not help: the ~300 GB 'Footage archive' is Daniel's folder shared with her, and shared files count against the owner's (Daniel's) quota, not hers. Her ~92 GB of her 100 GB quota is used by files she owns.
questions.must_not_claim: the shared footage folder uses up her quota

questions.question: Oduya Foods says the year-end pack link we sent them doesn't open anymore. Why?
questions.gold: The link was a public link created by Femi Balogun, whose account was disabled on 30 October 2026. When a user is disabled, all their public-link and email shares stop being accessible (internal shares keep working). Someone active, e.g. Ngozi, has to share the pack again with a new link.
questions.must_not_claim: the link should still work because disabling an account keeps everything shared
sources: nextcloud-32-admin-manual p.426 (19.1.7 Disable and enable users)

questions.question: Can our field auditors install the Nextcloud Files app on their company phones?
questions.gold: Not on their current phones: the six auditors' company Samsung phones are stuck on Android 8.0, and the Files app needs Android 8.1 or newer (iOS 15+ on iPhone). The phones must be updated or replaced.
questions.must_not_claim: the Files app works on the auditors' Android 8.0 phones

questions.question: Why do the big sensor bundles keep failing when Jiří copies them into the institute's folder?
questions.gold: The 'terrasonda-raw' folder is a federated share from the institute's Nextcloud, and requests to federated servers time out after 30 seconds by default; the 300-450 MB bundles take longer, so they fail after about half a minute while small files work. The fix is a higher davstorage.request_timeout in config.php on her instance.
questions.must_not_claim: federated transfers have no timeout, so the problem must be on the institute's server

questions.question: Ines wants the Village-B interviews back, but they're not in her trash bin. Where can they be restored from?
questions.gold: From Hana's own trash bin (she owns Interviews-2026) or from Marek's, since he deleted it on 10 November: a folder deleted by a recipient goes to the trash bin of the owner and of the recipient who deleted it, not to other recipients like Ines.
questions.must_not_claim: only Marek, who deleted it, can restore it from his trash
sources: nextcloud-32-user-manual p.29 (3.3.2 What happens when shared files are deleted)

questions.question: I renamed the 'Clients 2026' folder I share with the freelancers to 'Clients Active'. What name will they see?
questions.gold: They keep seeing the old name 'Clients 2026': when the owner renames a shared file or folder, the new name is not reflected on the recipients' side.
questions.must_not_claim: everyone she shared it with sees the new name immediately
sources: nextcloud-32-user-manual p.36 (3.6.2 Internal shares with users and groups)

questions.question: What address do I type into Transmit to connect to our Nextcloud over WebDAV?
questions.gold: The full WebDAV URL, not the plain server address: https://cloud.lumenstudio.design/remote.php/dav/files/USERNAME/ (with her own username).
questions.must_not_claim: Transmit connects with the same plain server URL as the official apps, https://cloud.lumenstudio.design

questions.question: Do I need to set a password when I share the payroll folder with a colleague inside Nextcloud?
questions.gold: No: 'Enforce password protection' only forces passwords on public share links; it does not apply to shares with users or groups inside Nextcloud.
questions.must_not_claim: with password enforcement on, even shares with colleagues inside Nextcloud need a password

questions.question: Now that server-side encryption is on, can your admins still read our client files?
questions.gold: Yes, they could: server-side encryption uses the master key mode by default, where all files are encrypted with a central server-controlled key and admins can decrypt any user's files.
questions.must_not_claim: with server-side encryption on, not even the hosting provider can read the files

questions.question: If I send the funders the draft report as a public link with Hide download on, can they still keep a copy?
questions.gold: Possibly yes: 'Hide download' only hides the download buttons and the browser's default right-click options to make downloading harder; it does not make saving a copy impossible.
questions.must_not_claim: turning on Hide download guarantees the recipient cannot save a copy of the file

questions.question: What's the biggest single file I can upload?
questions.gold: 14 GB on her instance, because of approved exception SUP-5207 (upload_max_filesize and post_max_size set to 14G) instead of the default 512 MB; her storage quota still applies.
questions.must_not_claim: the limit is 512 MB

questions.question: What's the biggest single file I can upload?
questions.gold: 512 MB, the default maximum upload file size; her instance has no raised limit.
questions.must_not_claim: the limit is 14 GB

questions.question: How long can my web login sit idle before Nextcloud makes me log in again?
questions.gold: 8 hours of inactivity on his instance, because of approved exception SUP-5263 ('session_lifetime' => 60 * 60 * 8) instead of the default 24 hours.
questions.must_not_claim: the session lasts 24 hours

questions.question: How long can my web login sit idle before Nextcloud makes me log in again?
questions.gold: 24 hours of inactivity, the default session_lifetime; her instance has no shorter setting.
questions.must_not_claim: the session expires after 8 hours

questions.question: How many calendars and calendar subscriptions am I allowed to create?
questions.gold: Up to 50 calendars and subscriptions combined on her instance, because of approved exception SUP-5318 (dav maximumCalendarsSubscriptions = 50) instead of the default 30.
questions.must_not_claim: the limit is 30

questions.question: How many calendars and calendar subscriptions am I allowed to create?
questions.gold: At most 30 calendars and subscriptions combined, the default limit; his instance has no raised limit.
questions.must_not_claim: the limit is 50

questions.question: Which update channels can I pick for the desktop sync app?
questions.gold: There are four update channels: Enterprise, Stable, Beta and Daily.
questions.must_not_claim: the desktop client only has Stable and Beta channels

questions.question: If Windows-compatible filenames get switched on, what can we still do with old files whose names aren't allowed?
questions.gold: Users can no longer create or modify files with invalid names, but they can still delete them or rename them to valid names.
questions.must_not_claim: old files with invalid names are locked and cannot be renamed or deleted

questions.question: With server-side encryption turned on, are our file and folder names encrypted too?
questions.gold: No: server-side encryption only encrypts file contents; file names and the folder structure are not encrypted.
questions.must_not_claim: server-side encryption also encrypts file and folder names

questions.question: Is there a limit to how deep a folder tree can be for the desktop client to still sync it?
questions.gold: Yes: the desktop client is intentionally limited to syncing no deeper than 100 sub-directories; deeper folders are not synced.
questions.must_not_claim: the desktop client syncs folders of any depth
sources: nextcloud-32-user-manual p.237 (6.7.3 Syncing Stops When Attempting To Sync Deeper Than 100 Sub-directories)

questions.question: When I share a folder with someone on another company's Nextcloud server, what permission options do I get?
questions.gold: Only one: when creating a federated share the only share option is 'Can edit'.
questions.must_not_claim: federated shares offer the same fine-grained permissions (read-only, create, delete, reshare) as internal shares
sources: nextcloud-32-user-manual p.49 (3.14.1 Creating a new Federation Share)

questions.question: Can I install the Nextcloud desktop client on the mixing Mac in Studio B?
questions.gold: No: the Studio B mixing Mac runs macOS Big Sur 11, and the desktop client needs macOS Monterey 12 or newer (64-bit). He has to keep using the web interface there, or use another machine.
questions.must_not_claim: the desktop client can be installed on the Big Sur Mac

questions.question: The Lumen session archive is 6 GB. Can I upload it in the browser, or do I need another way?
questions.gold: Not in the browser: his Studio plan's browser upload limit is 2 GB per file. The desktop sync client is not affected by these upload limits because it uploads in smaller chunks, so he should put the archive in his synced folder.
questions.must_not_claim: the desktop client is limited to the same 2 GB as the browser

questions.question: Why can't I find Mikkel when I search the company address book in Contacts?
questions.gold: Because Mikkel set all of his profile fields to Private in his personal settings; users who set all their property scopes to Private are removed from the system address book and are not seen by other users.
questions.must_not_claim: every user always appears in the company address book
sources: nextcloud-32-admin-manual p.501 (Privacy and User Property Scopes)

questions.question: My reminder for the 9:00 call with a client only popped up at 9:11. Is something broken?
questions.gold: Probably not: without the dedicated reminder command, reminders are sent when the background jobs run, and on her instance background jobs run via cron every 15 minutes, so a reminder can arrive up to about 15 minutes late. Running occ dav:send-event-reminders more often (sendEventRemindersMode occ) would make them more punctual.
questions.must_not_claim: reminders are always sent at exactly the minute they are due

questions.question: When you move Paolo's files over to me at the end of the month, will his Glossaries-2024 folder come along?
questions.gold: No: Paolo deleted Glossaries-2024, so it is in his trash bin, and transferring ownership does not transfer trash bin contents. Paolo (or the admin) should restore it from his trash bin before the transfer on 30 November.
questions.must_not_claim: the deleted folder is transferred along with his other files
sources: nextcloud-32-admin-manual p.279 (13.1.4 Transferring files to another user)

questions.question: I'm switching on two-factor login for my account next week. Will my desktop sync client keep working with my normal password?
questions.gold: No: with two-factor authentication enabled, device-specific (app) passwords are the only way to configure clients; the server denies clients using the login password, so she must create an app password for the desktop client (and so will every colleague).
questions.must_not_claim: After enabling 2FA, your desktop client keeps working with your normal password.

questions.question: If we delete a former employee's account, how long do we have to change our minds and restore it?
questions.gold: Essentially no time: deleting a user removes the account and all its data immediately; the undo button is only available for a few seconds. Transfer or copy the files first.
questions.must_not_claim: Deleted users go to a trash and can be restored for 30 days.

questions.question: Should we delete our old calendars and contact lists to free up storage quota?
questions.gold: No point: calendar and contacts data is stored in the database and is excluded from the quota (as are thumbnails, cache and encryption keys); deleting them frees no quota. Large files like the raw takes are what count.
questions.must_not_claim: Your calendars and contacts eat into your file storage quota.

questions.question: Would switching Joost's Windows drive mapping to an app password make it any faster?
questions.gold: Yes: for third-party WebDAV clients, including the operating system's built-in one, you should log in with an application password; besides better security it increases performance significantly.
questions.must_not_claim: Using an app password for WebDAV only adds security; it makes no difference to speed.

questions.question: A freelancer got throttled after wrong password attempts from her home. Is her account now slowed down on her other devices too?
questions.gold: No: brute-force throttling is based on the IP address, so the same account connecting from a different IP address is not affected.
questions.must_not_claim: Brute-force protection locks the user account everywhere, on every device.

questions.question: Do our MP3 files show their album cover as a thumbnail in Files?
questions.gold: Yes on his instance: approved exception SUP-6214 re-enabled the MP3 preview provider ('OC\Preview\MP3' in enabledPreviewProviders), so embedded album covers show as thumbnails again (by default this is off since 32.0.1).
questions.must_not_claim: MP3 cover thumbnails are disabled (default since 32.0.1)

questions.question: Do our MP3 files show their album cover as a thumbnail in Files?
questions.gold: No: starting with Nextcloud 32.0.1 the MP3 preview provider, which reads embedded cover images, is disabled by default for performance and stability reasons; her instance uses the default. The files are not damaged; an admin could add 'OC\Preview\MP3' to enabledPreviewProviders.
questions.must_not_claim: MP3 covers are shown as thumbnails on her instance

questions.question: How long can an app password go unused before Nextcloud deletes it?
questions.gold: 2 years on her instance: approved exception SUP-6271 set token_auth_token_retention to 63072000 seconds instead of the default 365 days. Remote-wipe passwords are still deleted after 60 days without use.
questions.must_not_claim: unused app passwords are deleted after 365 days

questions.question: How long can an app password go unused before Nextcloud deletes it?
questions.gold: 365 days: since Nextcloud 30 app passwords of client applications are deleted after 365 days of no usage (passwords set for remote wipe after 60 days); her instance uses the default.
questions.must_not_claim: unused app passwords are kept for 2 years

questions.question: How long can I still get back a calendar event I deleted?
questions.gold: 7 days on her instance: approved exception SUP-6338 set calendarRetentionObligation to 604800 seconds, so deleted calendars, events and tasks are purged from the calendar trash bin after 7 days instead of the default 30. The files trash bin is not affected.
questions.must_not_claim: deleted events stay in the calendar trash bin for 30 days

questions.question: How long can I still get back a calendar event I deleted?
questions.gold: 30 days: deleted calendars, events and tasks go to the calendar trash bin and are purged after the default delay of 30 days; his instance uses the default.
questions.must_not_claim: deleted events are purged after 7 days

questions.question: I can't find a Contacts app anywhere in our menu. Where is it?
questions.gold: The Contacts app is not enabled by default in Nextcloud 32; it has to be installed separately from the App Store (an admin can install it).
questions.must_not_claim: the Contacts app is always part of Nextcloud 32 and is just hidden
sources: nextcloud-32-user-manual p.53 (4.1 Using the Contacts app)

questions.question: If we switch on encryption, is there anything that still stays unencrypted?
questions.gold: Yes: old files in the trash bin, image thumbnails from the Gallery app, previews from the Files app and the full-text search index are never encrypted.
questions.must_not_claim: everything, including the trash bin and thumbnails, gets encrypted

questions.question: The admin overview warns that no memory cache is configured. Do we have to fix that for Nextcloud to work?
questions.gold: No: a memcache is not required; the warning can safely be ignored (configuring one, e.g. APCu as 'memcache.local', only improves performance and clears the warning).
questions.must_not_claim: Nextcloud will not work properly without a memory cache

questions.question: The Mail app won't accept our old mail server at 10.0.0.3 as the IMAP host. Why not?
questions.gold: By default Nextcloud does not allow local hostnames and IP addresses (like localhost or 10.0.0.3) as remote IMAP/SMTP/Sieve servers in the Mail app; an admin would have to allow local remote servers ('allow_local_remote_servers' => true).
questions.must_not_claim: the Mail app can connect to any IMAP server, so the server itself must be broken
sources: nextcloud-32-admin-manual p.504 (Local IMAP and SMTP servers)

questions.question: Bisi starts next week and I'll add her to the Buyers group. Will she be able to open Wholesale 2026 on her first day, or do I have to share it with her again?
questions.gold: She'll have it straight away: Wholesale 2026 is shared with the Buyers group (Amara shared it in March 2026), and new group members immediately get access to the file shares of their groups, so no reshare is needed.
questions.must_not_claim: she only sees shares created after she joined, so the folder must be shared again

questions.question: Is the old Nextcloud on our workshop server still getting maintenance updates?
questions.gold: No: the workshop server runs Nextcloud 30, first released in September 2024, and each major release is only supported for one year from its initial release, so it reached end-of-life around September 2025 and should be upgraded.
questions.must_not_claim: Nextcloud 30 is still supported

questions.question: If your data centre lost our server completely, could we restore our Nextcloud from the copy on our studio NAS?
questions.gold: Not completely: Hamish's weekly NAS copy only has the data directory and a database dump, not the configuration files, and a restore needs all three (database, data directory and configuration files); the config files have to be added to the copy.
questions.must_not_claim: the NAS copy is enough to restore the instance

questions.question: Can I still go back and correct the delivery date in the message I sent the Harlows in Talk on Saturday?
questions.gold: No: Talk messages can only be edited up to 6 hours after sending, and that message was posted on Saturday 14 November at 8:40, about three days ago; she has to send a new message with the correct date (the 21st).
questions.must_not_claim: she can still edit the message

questions.question: If we connect our sales dashboard to Nextcloud with OAuth2, will it only be able to read the Sales Reports folder?
questions.gold: No: Nextcloud OAuth2 tokens are not scoped; every token has full access to the complete account, including read and write access to all stored files.
questions.must_not_claim: an OAuth2 app can be limited to read-only access to one folder

questions.question: We're switching to adirehouse.com. Can we just move our Nextcloud to the new domain by updating trusted_domains?
questions.gold: No: changing the domain after the first setup is currently not supported by Nextcloud.
questions.must_not_claim: the domain can be changed any time by editing trusted_domains

questions.question: Before I run the built-in updater on the workshop server, do I need to back up the database myself?
questions.gold: Yes: the built-in updater does not back up the database or the data directory (only the code), so both must be backed up separately before updating.
questions.must_not_claim: the updater makes a full backup including the database
sources: nextcloud-32-admin-manual p.540 (23.4 Upgrade via built-in updater)

questions.question: If I tag client folders 'unpaid' in Files, can the rest of the team see that tag?
questions.gold: Yes: all tags are system tags, shared by all users on the Nextcloud server, so the others can see the 'unpaid' tag.
questions.must_not_claim: tags are private to the person who created them

questions.question: How long does the Activity stream keep our history before old entries are deleted?
questions.gold: 730 days on her instance, because of approved exception SUP-7104 ('activity_expire_days' => 730) instead of the default 365; a daily cron job deletes activity entries older than that.
questions.must_not_claim: her activity entries are deleted after 365 days

questions.question: How long does the Activity stream keep our history before old entries are deleted?
questions.gold: 365 days, the default activity_expire_days: a daily cron job deletes activity entries older than that; his instance has no extended retention.
questions.must_not_claim: his activity entries are kept for 730 days

questions.question: How often does the Mail app check our mailboxes for new mail in the background?
questions.gold: Every 20 minutes on his instance, because of approved exception SUP-7162 ('app.mail.background-sync-interval' => 1200) instead of the default hourly sync (3600 seconds).
questions.must_not_claim: his mailboxes are synced in the background every hour

questions.question: How often does the Mail app check our mailboxes for new mail in the background?
questions.gold: Every hour: the default background sync interval is 3600 seconds (the minimum allowed is 300 seconds); her instance uses the default.
questions.must_not_claim: her mailboxes are synced in the background every 20 minutes

questions.question: Is there a limit on how big a photo can be before Nextcloud stops making a thumbnail preview for it?
questions.gold: Yes, but higher than default on her instance: approved exception SUP-7219 set 'preview_max_memory' to 1536, so preview generation may use up to 1536 MB per image (default 256 MB); images that need more still show a generic icon.
questions.must_not_claim: previews are limited to 256 MB of memory per image on her instance
sources: nextcloud-32-admin-manual p.329 (Maximum memory for image generation)

questions.question: Is there a limit on how big a photo can be before Nextcloud stops making a thumbnail preview for it?
questions.gold: Yes: by default preview generation may use at most 256 MB of memory per image; images that need more get a generic icon instead of a thumbnail. Her instance uses the default.
questions.must_not_claim: previews may use up to 1536 MB per image on her instance
sources: nextcloud-32-admin-manual p.329 (Maximum memory for image generation)

questions.question: We might move our storage to an S3 bucket later. In Nextcloud 32, is S3 data integrity checking switched on by default?
questions.gold: No: from Nextcloud 32.0.3 the S3 data integrity protections are disabled by default and are opt-in.
questions.must_not_claim: Nextcloud 32 always forces S3 checksum validation on every upload

questions.question: Can we stop the OAuth2 confirmation screen from appearing for our own in-house tool?
questions.gold: Partly: the default OAuth2 flow shows one confirmation before login (if the user is not logged in yet) and a second one after login. The pre-login one can be skipped for a trusted application by setting skipAuthPickerApplications through occ, e.g. occ config:app:set oauth2 skipAuthPickerApplications --type array --value '["myapplication"]'.
questions.must_not_claim: the OAuth2 confirmation screens can never be skipped

questions.question: On a freshly installed Nextcloud, is support for the old legacy encryption format turned on?
questions.gold: No: starting with version 20, legacy encryption support is off by default for new installations; only upgraded installs may still have it and can check with occ encryption:scan:legacy-format.
questions.must_not_claim: legacy encryption support is always enabled

questions.question: Which release channel does a Nextcloud server use if nobody changes anything?
questions.gold: The stable release channel: by default all Nextcloud installations use the stable channel.
questions.must_not_claim: new installs are on the beta channel

questions.question: Why do the origin icons for our coffee labels look so blurry when I preview them in Files?
questions.gold: Because they are tiny 64x64 pixel PNGs and Nextcloud's previews upscale small pictures up to 10 times their original size by default, which makes them look blurry; the admin can limit this with preview_max_scale_factor.
questions.must_not_claim: previews are never larger than the original picture

questions.question: Why can't Inês upload her roast logs from the roastery tablet anymore?
questions.gold: Because she is over her quota: her account has a 10 GB quota and was using 10.4 GB (mostly the farm tour videos). A user who exceeds the quota cannot upload or sync data until space is freed or the quota is raised.
questions.must_not_claim: going over quota only shows a warning and uploads keep working

questions.question: Where on our server do I find the Nextcloud log file?
questions.gold: In /srv/kumo-data/nextcloud.log: with file logging Nextcloud writes nextcloud.log into the directory set as datadirectory, and her data directory is /srv/kumo-data (the rest of her config.php is standard, no custom log path).
questions.must_not_claim: the log is in /var/log/nextcloud.log

questions.question: Can I still open the Talk chat from the rooftop safety briefing event to copy Mehmet's checklist?
questions.gold: Probably not: it is an event conversation, and event conversations are deleted automatically after 28 days of inactivity by default. Its last message was Mehmet's checklist on 30 September 2026, about 48 days ago, so it has most likely been deleted; he should use the printed copies in the vans.
questions.must_not_claim: the event conversation is kept forever like a normal conversation

questions.question: If Inês has the green coffee inventory sheet open, can Beatriz open and edit it at the same time?
questions.gold: Yes: several users can open and edit a file at the same time; transactional file locking does not prevent this, it only stops saves from happening at the same moment, so Beatriz does not have to wait.
questions.must_not_claim: file locking stops a second user from opening a file someone else has open

questions.question: If I add the Hanami-terms glossary to the 'Hanami Cosmetics launch' project, will Daisuke be able to open it?
questions.gold: Not because of the project: projects do not give anyone access to their items. Users only see another user's project if they have access to every item in it, so she has to share the glossary with Daisuke (or the team) first.
questions.must_not_claim: adding the file to the project shares it with everyone in the project

questions.question: During the database move on 5 December, can I keep checking the user list and settings in the web interface as admin while maintenance mode is on?
questions.gold: No: maintenance mode locks the sessions of all logged-in users, including administrators, and shows a maintenance status screen; nobody can log in until it is turned off, and afterwards logged-in users must refresh their browsers.
questions.must_not_claim: administrators can keep using the web interface during maintenance mode

questions.question: If our server ever has to be restored from a backup, will the desktop clients notice the changed files by themselves?
questions.gold: No, not by themselves: after restoring the data or database, occ maintenance:data-fingerprint must be run once; it changes the ETag of all files towards the sync clients so they realize files were modified. It belongs in the emergency plan's restore section.
questions.must_not_claim: the sync clients detect a restored backup automatically with no extra step

questions.question: How long does the Mail app wait for our mail server before it gives up?
questions.gold: 45 seconds for IMAP on his instance, because of approved exception SUP-8121 ('app.mail.imap.timeout' => 45) instead of the default 5 seconds; SMTP keeps the default 20 seconds. (Not the 120 seconds he asked for.)
questions.must_not_claim: the IMAP timeout is the default 5 seconds

questions.question: How long does the Mail app wait for our mail server before it gives up?
questions.gold: The defaults: 5 seconds for IMAP and 20 seconds for SMTP; her instance has no changed timeout.
questions.must_not_claim: the IMAP timeout is 45 seconds

questions.question: How often does Nextcloud check for people we removed from our LDAP directory?
questions.gold: Every 17 minutes on her instance, because of approved exception SUP-8150 ('ldapUserCleanupInterval' => 17) instead of the default 51 minutes (not the 5 minutes she asked for); each run still examines 50 users.
questions.must_not_claim: the check runs every 51 minutes

questions.question: How often does Nextcloud check for people we removed from our LDAP directory?
questions.gold: Every 51 minutes, the default ldapUserCleanupInterval, examining 50 users per run; removed users are not deleted immediately. His instance has no changed interval.
questions.must_not_claim: the check runs every 17 minutes

questions.question: How many calendar and contact changes does our server keep for syncing phones?
questions.gold: 25,000 sync-change entries on his instance, because of approved exception SUP-8174 (dav totalNumberOfSyncTokensToKeep = 25000) instead of the default 10,000 (not the 100,000 he asked for).
questions.must_not_claim: the server keeps the default 10,000 entries

questions.question: How many calendar and contact changes does our server keep for syncing phones?
questions.gold: 10,000 entries, the default; his instance has no raised value. Too few entries for a large instance can cause sync problems.
questions.must_not_claim: the server keeps 25,000 entries

questions.question: Where does Nextcloud write the log of our Flow automation rules?
questions.gold: By default the workflow (Flow) log is stored as flow.log in the Nextcloud data folder.
questions.must_not_claim: Flow events are written into nextcloud.log

questions.question: Does Apache itself limit how big a file a client that doesn't upload in chunks can send?
questions.gold: Yes: in recent Apache versions LimitRequestBody defaults to 1 GiB (it was unlimited up to 2.4.53), so uploads from non-chunking clients are limited to 1 GiB unless the admin sets it to 0 or a higher value.
questions.must_not_claim: Apache has no upload size limit of its own and only PHP limits matter
sources: nextcloud-32-admin-manual p.287 (13.3.2 Configuring your Web server)

questions.question: If nothing special is configured, where does Nextcloud keep its file locks?
questions.gold: In the database: transactional file locking uses the database locking backend by default, which places a significant load on the database; setting memcache.locking (e.g. to Redis) moves it off the database.
questions.must_not_claim: file locking uses Redis out of the box

questions.question: How can we make the heavy once-a-day background jobs run only at night?
questions.gold: Set maintenance_window_start in config.php to a UTC hour: background jobs that are not time-sensitive are then delayed during the day and only run in the 4 hours after that hour (e.g. 1 means 01:00-05:00 UTC). It only takes effect when background jobs run in cron mode.
questions.must_not_claim: there is no way to control when background jobs run

questions.question: How can we stop the Nextcloud desktop client on our prepress computers from updating itself?
questions.gold: Add skipUpdateCheck=true to the [General] section of the client's nextcloud.cfg file on each computer (on Windows the admin can instead add a skipUpdateCheck DWORD in the registry).
questions.must_not_claim: the desktop client's automatic updates cannot be turned off

questions.question: Layla's storage still seems stuck at the old limit even though I raised it. Why?
questions.gold: Layla is an LDAP user, and their directory gives every translator a 5 GB quota through the mapped quota attribute. For LDAP users the LDAP quota overrides the quota set on the Nextcloud Users page, so the 50 GB Noor set there on 8 June 2026 has no effect; the quota has to be raised in the LDAP directory (Layla's quota attribute) instead.
questions.must_not_claim: the 50 GB set on the Users page applies to Layla

questions.question: Rafael wants to let Gonzalo edit a customs manifest he shared with him. Has Lucía blocked that on our instance?
questions.gold: No: in April 2026 Lucía changed the Default share permissions to read-only, but default share permissions only set what new user shares start with and are not forced; Rafael can open the share and give Gonzalo the edit permission himself.
questions.must_not_claim: users cannot give edit rights because the admin's default share permissions are a hard limit

questions.question: Why does Nextcloud show 10.20.0.5 as the IP address for every researcher's login?
questions.gold: 10.20.0.5 is the university gateway (reverse proxy) Einar put in front of the instance in April 2026, and it only sends the client address in the X-Real-IP header. Behind a trusted proxy Nextcloud reads the client IP from the X-Forwarded-For header by default, so it never sees the real addresses and shows the proxy's. The gateway should send X-Forwarded-For, or forwarded_for_headers must be set to use X-Real-IP.
questions.must_not_claim: Nextcloud reads the client IP from X-Real-IP by default

questions.question: Jonas says the app store on his old university's Nextcloud lists apps that ours doesn't show at all. Why are they missing on ours?
questions.gold: Most likely because AppAPI was disabled on her instance on 26 August 2026, after Einar's security review. When AppAPI is disabled, apps that depend on it are not visible in the app store; re-enabling AppAPI would make them show up again.
questions.must_not_claim: disabling AppAPI has no effect on which apps the app store shows

questions.question: I made Ama an admin back in July, so why can't she get into the server's administration settings?
questions.gold: In July 2026 Kwame made Ama a group admin of the Production group, which is not a full administrator. To give her full (super) administrator rights he has to add her to the admin group.
questions.must_not_claim: being group admin of Production gives Ama full server administration rights
sources: nextcloud-32-admin-manual p.424 (19.1.4 Granting administrator privileges to a user)

questions.question: Samir is upgrading our old archive server from Nextcloud 29 to 32 in December. Can he do it in a single upgrade?
questions.gold: No: major releases cannot be skipped. He has to update to the latest 29 point release first and then upgrade one major at a time, 29 -> 30 -> 31 -> 32.
questions.must_not_claim: he can upgrade straight from 29 to 32 in one step

questions.question: If I set our instance's default language to Arabic, will our European freelancers get an Arabic interface too?
questions.gold: Not necessarily: the default language only applies when the browser sends no language preference and the user has not set their own language, so freelancers whose browsers ask for another language, or who picked one, keep theirs.
questions.must_not_claim: a default language forces every user's interface into Arabic

questions.question: Valentina shared the dispatch rota calendar with me. Where do I accept it so it shows up?
questions.gold: Nowhere: calendar shares cannot be accepted or rejected, so the shared calendar simply appears in his calendar list.
questions.must_not_claim: he must accept the calendar share (e.g. from a notification) before it shows up
sources: nextcloud-32-user-manual p.73 (4.2 Using the Calendar app)

questions.question: The field station Mac's Calendar is set up with our server's http:// address. Will it sync once the password is right?
questions.gold: No: macOS does not support syncing CalDAV/CardDAV over non-encrypted http:// connections, so it will not sync with http://sky.nordlys-hav.no whatever the password; it has to use the https:// address.
questions.must_not_claim: macOS syncs CalDAV over http:// as long as the password is right

questions.question: When we create a new document in Nextcloud Office, what file format does it use?
questions.gold: OpenDocument Format (ODF, e.g. .odt or .ods) by default, not .docx/.xlsx; an admin can change this with 'Use OOXML by default for new files' in Administration settings > Nextcloud Office.
questions.must_not_claim: Nextcloud Office creates .docx/.xlsx files by default

questions.question: Is there a size limit on attachments I send from the Mail app?
questions.gold: Yes: 12 MiB (12582912 bytes) on his instance, because of approved exception SUP-9112 ('app.mail.attachment-size-limit'); larger attachments are refused and should be sent as a share link instead.
questions.must_not_claim: the Mail app has no attachment size limit on his instance

questions.question: Is there a size limit on attachments I send from the Mail app?
questions.gold: No: by default the Mail app has no attachment size limit (the default value of 0 bytes means no limit), and her instance uses the default.
questions.must_not_claim: her attachments are limited to 12 MiB

questions.question: If one of our external storages fails to log in, how long before Nextcloud tries it again?
questions.gold: 420 seconds on her instance, because of approved exception SUP-9147 ('external_storage.auth_availability_delay' => 420), instead of the default 1800 seconds (30 minutes).
questions.must_not_claim: her external storage stays unavailable for 30 minutes

questions.question: If one of our external storages fails to log in, how long before Nextcloud tries it again?
questions.gold: 30 minutes: after an authentication failure an external storage is flagged unavailable for 1800 seconds by default, and his instance uses the default.
questions.must_not_claim: the storage is retried after 420 seconds

questions.question: After I change someone in our company directory, how long can it take before Nextcloud shows the change?
questions.gold: Up to 240 seconds on his instance: approved exception SUP-9183 set the LDAP Cache Time-To-Live (ldapCacheTTL) to 240 seconds instead of the default 10 minutes.
questions.must_not_claim: LDAP changes can take up to 10 minutes to show on his instance

questions.question: After I change someone in our company directory, how long can it take before Nextcloud shows the change?
questions.gold: Up to 10 minutes: LDAP answers are cached for 10 minutes by default (Cache Time-To-Live setting), and his instance uses the default.
questions.must_not_claim: LDAP changes show up within 240 seconds
